question: Do v8's explicit resid10, attention-source, and MLP-write variables form one reusable aspectual state across A1 and A2, rather than only across prefix variants within each family?

novelty_search.result: The completed construction-interchange screen matched A1 to A1 and A2 to A2. No receipt exchanges the explicit variable groups between A1 and A2.

frozen_design.population: All 64 lexical/fresh A1/A2 rows. Within each panel, target A1 is paired to source A2 and target A2 to source A1 by reporter, object_name, and direction_id.
frozen_design.swap_semantics: Identical to the released construction-interchange runner except that source is the opposite A family in the same lexical/fresh panel. Target base-resid18, answer/foil IDs, outcome denominator, global weights, and recurrence remain fixed.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_capability_and_: All hashes, exact A1/A2 bijections, native capability, and reconstruction controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_target_program_effect: target_full is positive with at least 0.75 direction in all four target panels.
predictions.pred_c_whole_family_transfer: source_full retains at least 0.50 of target_full recovery and 0.75 direction in all panels.
predictions.pred_d_groupwise_cross_family_equivalenc: Each single-group swap retains at least 0.75 of target_full recovery and 0.75 direction in all panels.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage_and_price: All 320 records are unique within the parent screen's 72-forward/576-evaluation ceiling and zero fit/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: A1 and A2 share operationally equivalent explicit aspectual variables under the registered reader.
terminal.null: Authority, target effect, and coverage pass but whole-family or a named group is family-specific.
terminal.invalid: Authority, pairing, capability, reconstruction, target effect, or coverage fails.
